g.text: TPD-D01

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: In 21 months this index went from mostly inference to mostly evidence

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: the disclosed floor as a percentage of the estimate standing above it, at each of the 12 quarters the

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: estimate is evaluated. Both series are on TPD-01; the ratio between them is not, and it is the measure of how much of this

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: index is evidence rather than inference.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Tokens Per Day (tokensperday.com) — tokens_per_day_total.csv — chartData objects and evidence ledger as extracted 2026-08-21

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows the Tokens Per Day published methodology and estimates pages

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: The floor was 6% of the estimate in Oct 2024 and is 83% now. Almost all of that closure is four disclosures arriving between January

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: and June 2026 — China's national aggregate, Google at I/O, Fireworks and OpenAI's API figure — not a change of method. The remaining

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: 60.1T/day is the part no company has stated, and TPD-D04 shows how wide the estimates for it are. The floor is carried forward

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: between disclosures, exactly as the site's own tooltip does, so each step is a new statement rather than growth.
